purpose: Blindly derive the minimum English source-supported term additions needed to repair missed development or hidden-seed recall without changing the target construct.
allowed_inputs: The named blind H1 repair worksheet
rules: Use only exact English title, abstract, or citation substrings supplied in the worksheet.
Add a term only when it is needed for the missed seed and remains within the current logical-query construct and evidence role.
Synonyms and inflections remain in the existing logical family; do not propose a new logical query merely for wording.
Keep domain, paper-object, and measurement/prediction/validation context blocks distinct.
Decision must be accept, revise, or reject and must include a source-grounded reason.
Do not use anticipated K/Q/P or final indicator counts.
